title: 2026 Elections: Up to six candidates can be voted for in the first round
seoTitle: 2026 Elections: Up to 6 Candidates in First Round
subtitle: Voters will have the opportunity to choose up to six names at the ballot box in the first round of the 2026 elections
excerpt: In the first round of the 2026 Elections, voters will be able to select up to six candidates, according to official guidelines.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
For the first round of the 2026 Elections, voters have the option to choose up to six candidates. This rule determines the maximum number of names that can be registered on the ballot or electronic voting machine during the first phase of the race.

How the candidate selection works

Upon receiving the ballot or accessing the electronic interface, the voter has the option to mark or select up to six names. If they wish to vote for fewer candidates, they simply leave the remaining slots blank. The system only accepts up to six choices, preventing any further options from being registered.

Voting order

The voting order follows the sequence established by the bodies responsible for organizing the elections. Each voter follows the same procedure, marking or selecting their desired candidates within the limit of six choices.

  • Up to six candidates can be chosen;
  • The limit applies only to the first round;
  • The voting order is defined by electoral regulations.

These guidelines govern the voting process, ensuring that all voters have the same opportunity to express their preference within the maximum number of permitted candidates.

With information from Agência Brasil.
